scope_limits: Production signature/admission code reads actual signed inputs, but filesystem capacity, grouping and allocation sizes are injected, not measured on either radio.

The separate reference resident-state ledger plus native staging requirement is conservative under its explicit two-generation/state/metadata assumptions. It is not the measured whole-volume high-water or a verified transaction timeline.
Current public artifacts use the retained development publisher. No actual6300 install/network/profile/Linux2.6 qualification occurs.

The1MiB state allowance and metadata allowance are model assumptions, not whole-volume quotas. Legacy state, other waveform data, firmware-retained uploads, first-install extraction and another full release copy are additional.
ARMv7 first-install adapter is still missing. Signed transport input staging must remain in RAM; a rounded41MB free report cannot establish actual free blocks/inodes or safe installation capacity.

The wrapper is compiled for the local host and injects statvfs/devices/capacities. It verifies current production allocation arithmetic and signed-input admission, not ARM filesystem ABI, actual free blocks/inodes, storage ordering or power-loss persistence.
All production boot C/header/build input files match the source snapshot of the closed83d6 artifact. Only the offline probe, mutation sources and reference ledger are new.

The modeled storage sum includes the native8MiB reserve, which is not itself allocated file data. Explicit resident/state/metadata assumptions must not be read as measured volume usage or enforced whole-volume quotas.

The actual6300 first-install adapter, firmware-retained upload/extraction copies, filesystem layouts/free blocks/inodes and high-water measurements remain required. The supplied rounded41MB report alone cannot approve an installation.
The existing6300 readiness kit and its original source/package hashes are unchanged. This report refreshes current package references and does not silently replace that kit.
The prepared one5W DSPAPI-loss test is still pending explicit operator keying approval. No new radio/RF/sourcearm action or change to the original failed keyed case.
FullP1-P10, natural128/cold-bypass, remaining final-graph failures/foreign/credential/stale-cache, repeated/raw/extended RF, final stock/native/publisher and independent release gates remain open.
next_step: Use the current artifact ledger in actual6300 qualification, obtain real block sizes/free blocks/inodes and account for final adapter/native-waveform retention before installing. Keep pending RF completion proof separate and never infer approval from elapsed time.
